IMPERIA COLD WAR
# Universal SSR focus concept

Approval draft, 25 October 2026. No loaded game content is changed.


## UKR: Ukrainian SSR

First Secretary: Petro Shelest.


### COLDWAR_SSR_secretariat: Republican Mandate

Our republic stands between the ambitions of its people and the demands of a continental Union. The republican administration must turn ministries, local councils and industrial managers into a government capable of securing investment and delivering what it promises.

Position: (8, 0). Cost: 5; 35 days. SSR programme.

Prerequisites (groups are AND; entries are OR): []

Effects:

- Add Republican Administration
- Political power gain +5%
- Bureaucracy expenditure multiplier +3%


### COLDWAR_SSR_moscow_cadres: Union Appointments

Officials with experience in the Union ministries know where allocations are decided and which signatures open doors. Bringing them into our administration will strengthen those connections, although republican priorities may receive less generous consideration when the centre issues its instructions.

### COLDWAR_SSR_secretariat: Republican Mandate

Our republic stands between the ambitions of its people and the demands of a continental Union. The republican administration must turn ministries, local councils and industrial managers into a government capable of securing investment and delivering what it promises.

### COLDWAR_SSR_ARM_special_navy_mandate: Maritime Industry

Shipyards, repair docks and maritime schools can give the republic a distinctive role in the Union's naval affairs.
